title: Match Them Before Paint
hook: The ramp is still yours. Their speed is not.
scene: Wind, morning, I-5 south on-ramp. You are in the acceleration stretch. The right travel lane of the highway is a moving line of boxes. A gap is forming behind a dirty day-cab. Your stalk is still off. The merge paint is coming. If you arrive slow you steal his brakes. If you arrive with no signal he never knew you were a sentence.
decision: You are in the acceleration stretch. How do you join them?

options.text: Hold your ramp speed and slide over at the paint — they will lift for a bus
options.result: You meet the paint still slow. The day-cab stands on it. You borrowed a truck's stopping distance to finish a merge you should have matched first.

options.text: Signal, match their speed here, then take the gap in the merge stretch
options.result: Amber talks. You run the stretch up to their number. The gap you take is one you already paid for with speed. The stalk dies after you sit.

options.text: Stop now and wait for a hole that is already empty for a quarter mile
options.result: You plant it in the acceleration stretch. The ramp behind you becomes a standing start. Highways do not empty for a stopped bus.

options.text: Cut left across two highway lanes so you are not stuck on the right
options.result: You take two lanes from a ramp. The first sedan lifts. The second never had a sentence. You spent two gaps to skip the job.

debrief: Signal in the acceleration stretch. Match their speed. Take the gap at the merge. You took their paint at their number.

source.psdp_skill: Skill eleven: highway driving – part one
source.teaching_target: On the acceleration area, signal and match traffic flow; enter in the merge area; do not stop on the ramp.
